scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @team-task-system/web" "npm run dev -w @team-task-system/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @team-task-system/contracts && npm run build -w @team-task-system/api && npm run build -w @team-task-system/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @team-task-system/contracts && npm run test -w @team-task-system/contracts && npm run test -w @team-task-system/api && npm run test -w @team-task-system/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @team-task-system/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @team-task-system/api && npm run typecheck -w @team-task-system/web
